tools.name: reusery_catalog
tools.description: List the engineering capabilities Reusery knows, or inspect one primitive with its contract and ordered requirements. Read-only capability discovery, not a registry dump.

primitive_id.description: Opaque Reusery primitive id. Omit to list the known capabilities instead.

contract.description: The requested contract, or null in list mode.

requirements.description: Requirements in authored order; never null.

kind.description: Requirement kind from the intent vocabulary.

required.description: Whether satisfaction is mandatory for direct reuse.

primitive.description: The requested primitive, or null in list mode.

contract_id.description: The contract that describes this primitive.

contract_summary.description: One-paragraph contract summary, empty when the contract is not stored.

primitives.description: Capability list; empty in detail mode.

contract_id.description: The contract that describes this primitive.

contract_summary.description: One-paragraph contract summary, empty when the contract is not stored.

tools.name: reusery_discover
tools.description: Discover plausible public specimens for a known primitive and contract through the bounded Packet 5 providers. Provider data is INFO/UNKNOWN only: discovery is not verification and can never produce behavioural evidence.

reuse_modes.description: Reuse modes the specimen declares; never null.

revision.description: Pinned revision when one is known.

providers.description: Per-provider reports including partial failures; never null.

status_code.description: Upstream status code, when one exists.

succeeded.description: Whether the provider completed without operational failure.

tools.name: reusery_enrich
tools.description: Record attributable licence, advisory, dependency and maintenance metadata for discovered specimens. Metadata is never behavioural evidence and can never satisfy a contract requirement.

specimen_ids.description: Opaque Reusery specimen ids to enrich; must be non-empty, unique and within the run budget.

evidence.description: Total new observations recorded across all specimens.

status_code.description: Upstream status code, when one exists.

succeeded.description: Whether the provider completed without operational failure.

supported.description: Whether any provider supported this specimen.

tools.name: reusery_inspect_evidence
tools.description: Read a bounded, ordered page of stored evidence for one subject. Call this only when uncertainty actually matters; claims are returned unabridged.

after.description: Continuation key from a previous page; omit for the first page.

evidence_id.description: id of the last returned record.

observed_at.description: observed_at of the last returned record.

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 20 and may not exceed 50.

subject_id.description: Opaque Reusery specimen id whose evidence is wanted.

evidence.description: Observations ordered by observed_at then id; never null.

applies_to.description: Requirement id this observation applies to; empty for non-behavioural evidence.

license.description: Declared licence when the source declares one.

path.description: Path within the source when applicable.

revision.description: Pinned revision when one is known.

next_after.description: Continuation key for the next page, or null when the page is the last one.

evidence_id.description: id of the last returned record.

observed_at.description: observed_at of the last returned record.

tools.name: reusery_inspect_resolution
tools.description: Read a remembered Resolution exactly as recorded, together with any outcome events reported against it. Never re-evaluates current evidence.

resolution_id.description: PostgreSQL storage identity of the resolution.

outcome_feedback.description: Post-resolution events in chronological order; never null.

kind.description: adopted, rejected, integration_succeeded, integration_failed or abandoned.

outcome.description: reuse, adapt, depend, reference or build_locally.

policy_id.description: Policy profile that justified the decision.

reasons.description: Why it was rejected; never null.

tools.name: reusery_project_context
tools.description: Inspect a stored project: fingerprint summary, active remembered preferences and recent decisions. Contains no source code and no filesystem path.

limit.description: Recent resolutions to return; defaults to 20.

active_preferences.description: Memories that still influence decisions; never null.

int_value.description: Numeric ceiling, for a dependency limit.

primitive_id.description: Primitive scope, when the memory is scoped.

source_reason.description: Structured feedback reason that produced it.

text_value.description: Exact value, for example a denied licence.

direct_dependencies.description: Sum of direct requirements across modules.

indirect_dependencies.description: Sum of indirect requirements across modules.

replacements.description: Sum of replace directives across modules.

fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest fingerprint.

modules.description: One line per module; never null.

go_version.description: Declared Go version, or the workspace's.

outcome.description: reuse, adapt, depend, reference or build_locally.

project_context_hash.description: Immutable context snapshot the decision saw.

source_locator.description: Public repository and subdirectory; empty for local.

source_revision.description: Immutable commit SHA for a public scan.

tools.name: reusery_project_forget
tools.description: Revoke a remembered project preference. The historical row is kept, so forgetting is idempotent and the decision history stays inspectable.

tools.name: reusery_project_remember
tools.description: Remember an explicit project preference derived from stored candidate facts. Supply a structured reason, never a preference value: Reusery derives the value from what it already knows. This is the only way a preference is created - reusery_refine and reusery_report_outcome never write memory on their own. Remember only when the preference should apply beyond the current decision.

primitive_id.description: Primitive the memory is scoped to.

reason.description: not_quite, too_many_dependencies, licence_not_allowed, avoid_dependency, avoid_reference or archived_project.

source_resolution_id.description: Resolution the memory was derived from.

created.description: False when an identical active memory already existed.

effect.description: Deterministic description of what the memory changes.

tools.name: reusery_project_scan
tools.description: Derive a bounded project fingerprint from manifests only. It reads go.work and go.mod files, never source code, and never runs go or git. A local scan uses the project root configured on the server and never records a filesystem path; a github_public scan reads only a public repository at an immutable commit. Project context may change fit; it is never evidence.

ref.description: Optional git ref resolved to an immutable commit SHA.

repository.description: Public repository as owner/repo. Required for github_public.

source.description: local or github_public. Defaults to local.

direct_dependencies.description: Sum of direct requirements across modules.

indirect_dependencies.description: Sum of indirect requirements across modules.

replacements.description: Sum of replace directives across modules.

fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest fingerprint.

modules.description: One line per module; never null.

go_version.description: Declared Go version, or the workspace's.

project_id.description: Derived project identity; never a filesystem path.

source_locator.description: Public repository and subdirectory; always empty for a local project.

source_revision.description: Immutable commit SHA for a public scan; empty for local.

warnings.description: Safe notes about skipped input; never contains a path.

tools.name: reusery_refine
tools.description: Reject a result with a supported structured reason and re-resolve. Stateless: resend the original base policy, the same bounded candidate set and the complete accumulated feedback history.

candidates.description: The bounded candidate set; send [] when there are none.

reuse_mode.description: Reuse mode under consideration: copy, dependency, adapt or reference.

feedback.description: Complete accumulated feedback history using the supported vocabulary: not_quite, too_many_dependencies, licence_not_allowed, avoid_dependency, avoid_reference, archived_project. At least one item.

policy.description: The ORIGINAL base policy, not a previously derived effective policy. Omit for the built-in baseline.

max_direct.description: Maximum permitted direct dependencies. Omit for no quantity rule.

unknown.description: Action when the dependency count is unknown.

id.description: Policy profile identifier recorded on the resolution.

allow.description: Exact licence expressions that are allowed; never null.

deny.description: Exact licence expressions that are denied; never null.

multiple.description: Action when several licence expressions are observed.

unknown.description: Action when no licence is established.

unlisted.description: Action when the licence is known but not listed.

archived.description: Action when the source repository is archived.

deprecated.description: Action when the package is deprecated.

max_days_since_push.description: Staleness window in days. Omit to disable the rule.

max_days_since_release.description: Release age window in days. Omit to disable the rule.

stale.description: Action when the last push exceeds the configured window.

unknown.description: Action when a configured maintenance fact is unknown.

allowed.description: Reuse modes the policy permits; never null.

preferred.description: Permitted modes in preference order; never null.

known_advisory.description: Action when a known advisory identifier was reported.

unknown.description: Action when the advisory picture is unknown.

max_options.description: Maximum number of candidates in the shortlist.

missing_revision.description: Action when a required revision is missing.

require_revision_for.description: Reuse modes that require a pinned revision; never null.

project_id.description: Optional project identity. When supplied the decision is project-aware; when omitted Packet 9 semantics apply exactly.

applied_feedback.description: Feedback the server actually applied; never null.

outcome.description: reuse, adapt, depend, reference or build_locally; null when nothing was persisted.

project_context_hash.description: Immutable context snapshot the decision saw.

project_effects.description: Per-candidate project dependency fit; absent without project context.

project_id.description: Project whose context applied, or absent.

reasons.description: Deterministic reasons for the decision; empty when nothing was persisted.

rejected.description: Negative knowledge preserved on the resolution; never null.

reasons.description: Why it was rejected; never null.

resolution_id.description: Persisted resolution identity, or null when nothing was persisted.

disposition.description: Why this candidate could be used.

license.description: Declared licence when the source declares one.

revision.description: Pinned revision when one is known.

disposition.description: Why this candidate could or could not be used.

unknown_requirements.description: Required requirement ids still behaviourally unknown; never null.

status.description: resolved or needs_verification. Both are successful tool results.

unknowns.description: Required requirement ids still unknown across the assessed candidates; never null.

tools.name: reusery_report_outcome
tools.description: Record what actually happened after a Resolution was used. Append-only factual feedback: it is not Evidence, never changes a policy and never triggers a re-resolution. Report success only when integration really succeeded.

kind.description: adopted, rejected, integration_succeeded, integration_failed or abandoned.

note.description: Optional note of at most 1000 characters; never logged.

resolution_id.description: Storage identity of the resolution being reported on.

id.description: Storage identity of the recorded event.

tools.name: reusery_resolve

policy.description: Structured policy. Omit to use the built-in public-go-baseline/v1.

max_direct.description: Maximum permitted direct dependencies. Omit for no quantity rule.
